_description: Image search hints for fetch_images.py. Loaded at startup. Edit this file to improve future image fetches without touching the script.

brand_preferred_sources._note: Domains added here merge with BRAND_TRUSTED_DOMAINS in fetch_images.py (not replaced). Brand key must be lowercase.

sku_image_overrides._note: Map SKU → direct image URL. URL must pass Pillow aspect-ratio (0.8–1.2) and resolution (800×800) checks. Tried FIRST before any DDG query.

lessons_log.lesson: Auto-search returned LinkedIn company logo (media.licdn.com). Added linkedin.com to globally_blocked_domains. Item requires manual image — alcohol/chemical products often have no clean studio photo on DDG.
Auto-search returned a KOHEEL night guard appliance instead of flat thermoplastic sheeting. Product is raw material, not a finished appliance — stock images mislead. Added to manual_only_skus.

SKUs 400-120-001 through 400-120-004 are SNL's own brochures/catalogues. No valid product image exists on the web. All must be supplied manually by the SNL team. Added collection to manual_only_collections.
nutridentcompany.com appeared repeatedly in DDG results with low-quality images for Pearson products. Added to globally_blocked_domains. Pearsondentaluk.com is the preferred source.

First full audit-gate run: 33 of 42 auto-fetched images were WRONG despite passing size/ratio checks (suture boxes for brushes, ear spray for canal lubricant, a floor lamp for a footswitch, an electron microscope for expansion screws). Visual audit before Queue for Upload is MANDATORY. Colour-specific variants (endo stop colours) and niche lab items (ceramic brushes, mandrels, jigs) are hopeless for auto-search - marked manual-only. Also: watch for wrong shade (QwikTemp A1 got A3 image), wrong size (Unigloves L got M box, 25mm discs got 38mm), and near-miss products from the right brand (Dedeco point vs disc, AH Plus Jet vs paste kit).
Cattani Turbo Jet 1 and 2 auto-fetched each other's renders (swapped). For multi-model equipment families, verify the model label IN the image before accepting.

lessons_log.batch: Campaign slice 1 (65 items: endo, disposables, apparel)
lessons_log.lesson: New engine: 58/65 technical validation at ~1 CSE query/item (old engine burned up to 12), but visual audit accepted only 10 - long-tail generics (tray covers, mixing pads, cups, paper points) rarely have findable exact images. Recurring confusions: paper points fetch gutta-percha; rubber dam clamps fetch forceps; scrub tops fetch non-African model shots (people rule - need flat-lay product photos); colour/size variants still mismatch when siblings are not in the same batch (no forbidden tokens). These families are team-sourcing work, not search work - all 48 rejects appended to Image Queue tab with suggested sources.

lessons_log.batch: Fix Tracker daily maintenance (14 Open/Reopened rows)
lessons_log.lesson: CSE quota was already exhausted by the morning batch run, so this pass was CSE-free repair only. Live-Shopify defects found and removed: (1) brand-confusion wrong product - "Vivid Sticky Wrap" (dental barrier film) showed VViViD automotive vinyl wrap from vvividvinyl.com [blocked]; (2) logo-as-product - Pearson Thermoforming Sheet showed a bare "Pearson" wordmark from seeklogo [already blocked]; (3) reseller watermark - Castellini PiezoSteril showed a dentrealmarket.com watermarked photo [blocked]; (4) background-removal wrecks from an earlier build still live on Published products (Bicon Synthograft infographic, President Impression Tray jagged-halo cutout) - deleted from both Shopify and Zoho, reset to Image required; (5) non-square featured image (product_image.jpg 648x366) caused a "wrong size" complaint on 340-190-025 - deleted, leaving the three square 1296px images; (6) stale foreign-SKU gallery images (600-160-002 inside 600-160-001, 280-120-017 inside 280-120-016, 380-120-010 inside 380-120-007) removed. Lesson: deleting a bad Zoho image does NOT remove the already-published Shopify media - Reopened image complaints usually mean orphaned/duplicate Shopify media that must be deleted via productDeleteMedia directly.

lessons_log.batch: Daily maintenance fix-tracker (4 Reopened + 10 Open rows)
lessons_log.lesson: Verified-first pass. (1) All 4 Reopened rows (280-120-016, 400-140-004, 380-120-007, 200-110-022) were ALREADY resolved on live Shopify by the prior day's productDeleteMedia pass - Shopify media query showed 0 stale media (or the single correct image for 400-140-004); the rows were only Reopened because the sheet was never written back. Always re-query live Shopify media before re-doing a media deletion. (2) A brand's OWN 'official' source URL can still be a marketing infographic, not a clean packshot: bicon.com/SGFT.jpg (Synthograft) and reachtoothbrush.com ...ATF_6.jpg (Reach Advance) are both feature graphics with callout text - reject infographics even from the manufacturer domain. (3) Colgate 480-150-002 has a clean 2500px 2-brush render in Zoho but the exact 'Microsinic' model / single-vs-twin-pack is unverifiable - do not publish an unconfirmable model match. (4) pearsondental catalog thumbs can be tiny (President tray C59-0430 = 234x208) - too low-res to upscale. All routed to Image Queue for team sourcing (already in manual_only_skus). (5) Two logged SKUs (300-520-010, 270-150-001) do not exist in Zoho - Needs Manual, team to confirm SKU.

fetch_images.py BUG: when the found image's source URL exceeds 255 chars, the Zoho status write fails with 'Source URL value length cannot exceed 255' and the item errors out (does not record a normal failure). cf_source_url should be truncated/omitted to <=255 chars before the write. Low priority (the fetched Dynarex image was wrong-brand anyway) but worth fixing so long-URL CDN results don't error.

Daily maintenance: same Dynarex infographic bug as 200-220-002 sibling, now with a WORSE consequence understood. fetch_images.py uploads the image to Zoho (upload_image_to_zoho) BEFORE write_zoho_status; when the >255-char source URL makes the status write fail, the wrong image is LEFT on the item while status stays 'Image required' (silent bad-image leak, not caught by the default audit gate which only scans 'Image Validated'). Today the leaked image on 200-220-001 was a Dynarex marketing infographic (text overlay + brand watermark + a non-African child using a Junior 5in depressor) - triple rule violation for a Birchwood/JMU Senior 6in item. Deleted via reset_for_refetch. Actions: (1) added 200-220-001 AND 200-220-002 to manual_only_skus; (2) blocked walmartimages.com (reseller marketplace CDN repeatedly serving infographics with overlays); (3) both routed to Image Queue. Script fixes still pending for Leke: truncate cf_source_url to <=255 before write, AND delete-on-failed-write (or write status before/independently so a failed source-URL write cannot strand a wrong image).

lessons_log.batch: Daily maintenance auto-retry (65-item Campaign slice 1 batch)
lessons_log.lesson: Auto-fetch retry validated 15 images; visual audit ACCEPTED only 1 (260-130-056 BA International Ultimate Power+ BA755LK handpiece - exact model label verified in-image, clean square 1080px - queued for upload) and REJECTED 14, every one matching a previously-flagged Image-Queue failure. Confirmed the two chronic endodontic confusions once more: PAPER POINTS auto-fetch GUTTA-PERCHA (260-180-001 Roeko #20 -> roeko Guttapercha Greater Taper 0.04; 260-180-005 -> Guttapercha Top Color; 260-180-008 ProTaper Gold -> JMU gutta percha; also HyFlex CM assorted box for a Roeko #25) and RUBBER DAM CLAMPS auto-fetch FORCEPS or wrong-brand collages (260-200-006/010 -> clamp forceps, one TopDental-watermarked; 260-200-005 -> Medesy 14A/2A/00/8A collage without the 12A). Also: Bicon Integra-CP implant (320-120-022) fetched an ALGOR finite-element STRESS-ANALYSIS figure from a journal; Maillefer finger spreader (260-210-004) fetched a SybronEndo box; Black-Line plugger (260-210-003) fetched a Hu-Friedy instrument; PD Formocresol (260-170-003) fetched PD Tricresol & Formalin (right brand, wrong product). MD5 dupes across sibling sizes (260-180-002==003, 005==006) are a reliable wrong-image signal. All 14 added to manual_only_skus so fetch stops burning CSE quota on them; all were already in the Image Queue tab for team sourcing. Net: for these endo-points / rubber-dam-clamp / niche-implant families, auto-search yield is ~1/15 - they are team-sourcing work.

lessons_log.batch: Daily maintenance auto-retry (65-item Campaign slice 1 batch)
lessons_log.lesson: Auto-fetch validated 27 images; visual audit ACCEPTED only 2 and REJECTED 25 (yield ~2/27). ACCEPTED: 200-170-014 Unigloves Supergrip Latex Medium (box shows correct brand+material+size M, from phabcart.imgix.net) and 120-120-001 Cherokee Workwear Originals V-Neck Grape (clean flat lay with Originals red tag). REJECTED families, all confirming prior Image-Queue failures: generic no-brand DISPOSABLES are hopeless via CSE - Dental Mixing Pads fetched a fireplace shovel (200-180-001 from diy.com), a PPSU endoscope disinfection box (200-180-002), and a panda desk mouse pad (200-180-003 from etsystatic); Disposable Large Tray fetched a dental AIR COMPRESSOR (200-200-004 from picclickimg); UnoDent/N'SURE cups fetched a denture/bur soaking pot (200-200-002), a UnoDent cotton-rolls box (200-200-003), a Flow Dental film-holder (200-200-015) and a wheat-straw reusable-cup infographic (200-200-007); N'SURE tray covers fetched a matrix wedge (008), an x-ray PSP pouch (009), a 'dream' interdental-brush box (010), a Flow Dental PSP envelope (011) and a multi-colour assortment instead of the specific colour (012). GLOVE brand/material/size mismatches persist: BeeSure latex-large fetched BeeSure SuperSlim NITRILE 300 (200-170-001); Grip Touch latex XS fetched Micro-Touch Denta-Glove M nitrile (200-170-011); UnoDent Nitrisoft XS fetched the M box (200-170-026). Sponge Dispenser Mauve fetched the BLUE variant (200-120-005). Stoddard prophy brush fetched a UnoDent-branded identical-spec tray - BRAND mismatch, rejected (360-130-002). Exodontia gauze fetched a plastcareusa comparison INFOGRAPHIC with text (200-160-001). Rubber Dam Clamp 14A fetched a Medesy 14A/2A/00/8A collage (wrong brand + shows avoid-variants, 260-200-013); Rubber Dam Frame fetched Nyclave sterilization tubing (260-200-024). APPAREL confirmed manual-only: 120-120-032 Buttersoft Wine fetched a Christmas-monster-print top with a PhotoRoom watermark; 120-120-007 Cherokee 4876 Wine fetched a Cherokee 4101T PANTS infographic (wrong garment+text); 120-120-005/006 Cherokee Galaxy fetched byte-identical model shots of an unconfirmable Cherokee line (rejected - cannot verify 4876 model, apparel-manual-only). Also deleted an unaudited image on 260-180-004 (Roeko paper point) whose status-write had failed (source URL >255 chars) so it never reached the audit gate. All 26 added to manual_only_skus; diy.com, picclickimg.com, etsystatic.com blocked as non-dental junk sources. LESSON: generic no-brand disposable-supply families (mixing pads, disposable cups/trays/tray-covers, sponge dispensers) and apparel are team-sourcing work - CSE cannot resolve them; stop auto-retrying.
